# Erasmus

*1466 – 1536 · Dutch · [Renaissance humanism](../movements/renaissance-humanism.md)*

Dutch humanist, editor of the Greek New Testament and author of The Praise of Folly: he defends a "philosophy of Christ" founded on the return to sources and on free will, against Luther.
